headline: European countries condemn Russian incursion into Polish airspace
summary: Hungary's foreign minister Anita Orban called the Russian incursions into Polish airspace a serious threat to European security, as other European countries condemned them.
why: Airspace violations by Russia involving NATO members raise geopolitical tension and can affect European defence spending and risk sentiment.
original_headline: Países europeos condenan la incursión rusa en el espacio aéreo polaco
